q: Exercise Shakti is held between India and which country?
x: Shakti = India–France (army). Indra = Russia; Mitra Shakti = Sri Lanka; Garuda Shakti = Indonesia.

q: Which military exercise does India hold with Nepal?
x: Surya Kiran = Nepal. Sampriti = Bangladesh; Hand-in-Hand = China; Nomadic Elephant = Mongolia.

q: Which four countries take part in the Malabar naval exercise?
x: Malabar began as India–USA in 1992; Japan joined permanently in 2015 and Australia in 2020 (the Quad countries).

q: Who was India's first Chief of Defence Staff?
x: Bipin Rawat (from 1 January 2020). Then Anil Chauhan, and from May 2026 N.S. Raja Subramani.

q: Which is the oldest paramilitary force of India?
x: Assam Rifles, raised in 1835 as the Cachar Levy.

q: Which force guards India's borders with Nepal and Bhutan?
x: SSB guards Nepal and Bhutan. ITBP = China; BSF = Pakistan and Bangladesh; Assam Rifles = Myanmar.

q: Which Army rank is equal to a Wing Commander in the Air Force?
x: Wing Commander = Lt Colonel = Commander (Navy). Squadron Leader = Major; Group Captain = Colonel.

q: Which is the highest peace-time gallantry award?
x: Ashoka Chakra (peace time). Param Vir Chakra is the highest wartime award.

q: Where is the Indian Naval Academy?
The BrahMos missile is made by India with which country?
x: BrahMos = Brahmaputra + Moskva. It is a supersonic cruise missile.

q: What kind of missile is Akash?
x: Akash is a medium-range surface-to-air missile. Nag is anti-tank; Astra is air-to-air; Prithvi is surface-to-surface.

q: Which was India's first home-built aircraft carrier?
x: INS Vikrant, built at Cochin Shipyard, commissioned in September 2022. Vikramaditya was bought from Russia; Arihant is a submarine.

o: India's strikes on terror camps in Pakistan after the Pahalgam attack
Navy anti-piracy mission in the Red Sea
Relief mission after an earthquake in Myanmar
x: Strikes on terror camps in Pakistan and PoK after the April 2025 Pahalgam attack. Sudan evacuation was Operation Kaveri; Myanmar relief was Operation Brahma.

q: Where is the National Defence Academy?
x: NDA is at Khadakwasla. IMA is in Dehradun; Defence Services Staff College at Wellington.

q: Exercise Desert Flag is hosted by…
x: The UAE hosts Desert Flag at Al Dhafra air base.
